long_biography.plain_text:
In 1959, a newly graduated Jerry Edward Herbst left the University of Southern California for Las Vegas to join the oil company established by his father, Edward. When responsibility passed to him, he turned the existing operation's unusual nickname and cowboy logo into one of Southern Nevada's most recognisable brands.

Expansion combined roadside retail with vehicle services, while a separate regulated-gaming strand remained part of Herbst's career. Through JETT Gaming, he reclaimed slot routes at family stores and acquired the Searchlight casino; reporting explicitly distinguished that company from the one managed by his sons. Beyond commerce, Herbst served on the UNLV Foundation board, supported university education and spent decades racing, sponsoring and developing desert events.
long_biography.html:
In 1959, a newly graduated Jerry Edward Herbst left the University of Southern California for Las Vegas to join the oil company established by his father, Edward. When responsibility passed to him, he turned the existing operation's unusual nickname and cowboy logo into one of Southern Nevada's most recognisable brands.

Expansion combined roadside retail with vehicle services, while a separate regulated-gaming strand remained part of Herbst's career. Through JETT Gaming, he reclaimed slot routes at family stores and acquired the Searchlight casino; reporting explicitly distinguished that company from the one managed by his sons. Beyond commerce, Herbst served on the UNLV Foundation board, supported university education and spent decades racing, sponsoring and developing desert events.
